body:
23 Nov 2026, P2-25 SLICE 4, PR #118: THE DELTA LOOK at round 3 (3378b57), results and what the lead did. The tester re-attacked with ~1,650 fresh worlds of its own generator (normal, heavy with 2-6 arrivals and many tombstones, names at the 3 s boundary), a kill before every write transaction in both prune modes, listing down at pages 1-3: VERDICT approve, NO BLOCKER; arrival, tombstone displacement, the cap at 25/1/2, the prune (scan-only probe: 66 of 120 bad on the old statement, 0 of 120 now) all closed; backups, retry flag, no Host file touched, late like, contested target held up. The reviewer (16 mutants, 4 green) said changes-needed for ONE thing: no test spans the 400-id chunks of Rehome.page's arrivals query (its mutant that asks only the first chunk stayed green). Closed by the lead: two tests (the arrival as the third song of a page with _ARRIVAL_IDS=1; an arrival on a song that is not on the worklist is not judged), both of the reviewer's mutants are now RED; stale comments fixed.
CONCERNS KEPT AS TEXT, NOT FIXED HERE: (1) audit B-138, OLD CODE: refmerge.repair merges two refs that share only a file row the music server no longer lists (an add-only pass then a pruning pass; the start-up repair merges the same pair); merges cannot be undone; fix = refmerge counts only files Listing.alive leaves alive; to file. (2) _files_naming costs a round: 20 s of a 43 s verdict phase at 200,000 worklist files (docs/18 says so now); a real worklist is thousands. (3) B-137: a ref that ALREADY holds two preferred rows heals at the next touch and plays the same file meanwhile (said in the audit row). (4) the seam: besides the scan and the migration, the keeper can attach a row with NO id before it raises Retry (it counts as a kept file, which is right); a keeper row whose id the listing never has needs a music server whose search and listing disagree. (5) add-only-then-prune and prune-only can pick different preferred rows in some worlds (flags only, both fit). (6) the property test still does not generate pages over 400, prune=False passes, tombstones with an ISRC, owned kinds other than a like, or two refs sharing a file; the reviewer's own generator covers them (400 worlds, 0 failures).
THE TESTER'S AND REVIEWER'S FILES: local/rescued-23nov/attacker-118/ (round 1 probes) and the session scratchpad attacker-p225s4-round3-probes/. NOT DONE: the walk, any deploy.
